bug_semantics: CWE-22 path traversal in CrubadanCorpusReader._load_lang_ngrams: crubadan_code is table.txt column-0, joined onto the corpus root and opened with builtin open() instead of nltk.pathsec.open. After the 2015 cleanup to os.path.join, an absolute column-0 discards the root; relative .. also escapes. Attack is a malicious corpus package; disclosure is limited to *-3grams.txt contents that parse as token-count lines. Advisory window 3.9.4-3.10.2 is the period pathsec.ENFORCE existed but this reader still used raw open().
